subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Ben watched him draw a blue whale swimming across the gray sidewalk.”?
options: They also took pictures of the traffic.
People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.
They moved slowly, stopped for people, and waited for elevators.
Children made noisy songs, and old people smiled as they listened.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They also took pictures of the traffic.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Ben watched him draw a blue whale swimming across the gray sidewalk. People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「They moved slowly, stopped for people, and waited for elevators.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Ben watched him draw a blue whale swimming across the gray sidewalk. People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.」，答案為「People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
